verdict.rationale: Skyfire's KYA system lets agents prove identity with signed JWT tokens under the open KYAPay protocol. Optional Individual or Organization verification attaches a real-world identity, and sellers set identity requirements that block under-verified buyers. Docs also say a merchant's bot manager can identify the agent and let it through, and that an agentic purchase is "never anonymous." Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that merchants can verify tokens and tell agents from bots in practice, and detailed documentation of how a merchant checks the token signature (e.g. public keys/JWKS).
